messages.content: You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What hunch made Ayanokouji suspect old test papers were the key?

Chiyabashira seemed absolutely certain there was a way for everyone to pass despite knowing everyone's poor grades - implying a surefire method existed. This might explain how academically weak students like Sudou, Ike, and Yamauchi were admitted at all.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Ayanokouji use Kushida to motivate Sudou at the last moment?

He suddenly asks Kushida if she has a boyfriend and whether she'd date whoever scores fifty on the test; Kushida plays along, offering a date to whoever scores highest. Ike and Yamauchi immediately commit to fifty-one and fifty-two points, and a flustered Sudou quietly agrees to join.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Horikita treat Ayanokouji to an expensive lunch?
As an ulterior motive: she wants him to use his friendships with Sudou, Ike, and Yamauchi to bring them to a library study group that she will tutor, since she can't gather people herself.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What examples does the narrator give of modern Japanese society striving for equality?

He cites raising the employment rate for women, creating women-only subway cars, debates over the order of names in a family register, and avoiding terms like 'disabled people' so as not to discriminate.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Kushida distribute the old test papers to the class?

Right after homeroom the day before the midterm, she takes printed copies Ayanokouji made at the convenience store to the podium and hands them out, claiming a third-year student gave them to her last night and that the test two years ago had almost identical problems.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Sudou join a club?
He has played basketball since elementary school and joins the school's basketball team. He was also getting along well with Ike and Yamauchi by the time of the fair.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Who joins the group outing besides Kushida, Ike, Yamauchi, and Ayanokouji?
Hirata and his girlfriend Karuizawa, plus Matsushita and Mori, two girls who always hang around Karuizawa.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why are Class D students surprised by their teachers on the first day of class?
The teachers are genuinely warm and friendly, and they show no signs of noticing or caring that Sudou sleeps through class - it is left up to each individual student whether to listen.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Chiyabashira say academic ability alone doesn't determine class placement?

Because the school aims to produce superior people overall, not just smart ones. She notes Japan previously relied solely on test scores, which let incompetents kick down truly superior students, leading society to settle on hereditary succession instead.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Which famous work does the narrator cite when discussing the idea that everyone is born equal?
Gakumon no Sume, an incredibly famous work in which a great man said heaven does not set one man above or below any other, but also argued that education creates differences in status.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What excuse does Chiyabashira give for the midterm material change?

She claims the test topics changed the previous Friday and she 'forgot to inform' the class, then hands over new textbook page numbers - mostly covering material from before the study group started, leaving only one week.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What warning does Ike whisper to Ayanokouji about Kushida?
That he is aiming for Kushida romantically and warns Ayanokouji not to get in his way.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What hint had Chiyabashira given about the points system on the entrance ceremony day?
She had said 'the amount you've received reflects the evaluation of your worth' - meaning points vary based on merit - but barely anyone in Class D noticed the implication.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What surprises Ayanokouji about the range of clubs at the fair?
The substantial number of minor liberal arts clubs like tea ceremony and calligraphy, and that you need only three people minimum to form a new club.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What does Kushida reveal about first-year boys' popularity rankings?

Girls maintain anonymous ranking charts: Ayanokouji ranks fifth in 'hot guys' behind Satonaka (Class A), Hirata in second, and two other Class A boys - but also ranks high in 'gloominess.' Hirata scores well on looks and personality.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What does Horikita call Ayanokouji when describing him to Chiyabashira?

'Disagreeable' - because he gets low scores on purpose, devised the old-test plan yet gave Kushida credit, and was crazy enough to buy test points; he isn't merely special or unusual, he deviates from the norm in a disagreeable way.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What reason does Horikita give for refusing friendship at the café confrontation?
She has no intention of becoming friends with anyone in class; being alone doesn't make her sad, forcing friendship against someone's will is wrong, and trust cannot arise from something forced.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What martial arts credentials are revealed during the dorm confrontation?

Horikita's brother holds fifth dan in karate and fourth dan in aikido; Ayanokouji deflects questions by claiming he studied piano and calligraphy (and tea ceremony), mentioning winning a national music competition in elementary school.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Kushida react after Horikita leaves the café?
She briefly collapses into her seat, then instantly recovers with her usual smile, thanking Ayanokouji and saying that even though she failed, she learned something important.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does the narrator complete Fukuzawa's famous passage about equality at birth?

Everyone is equal when they are born, so why do we see differences in position and status? And do you or do you not encourage learning to create a difference? In other words, education creates an imbalance.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What study plan does Hirata organize before the midterms?

A daily two-hour study group in the classroom starting at five o'clock until the test, led by high-scoring students, open to anyone - warning that failing means expulsion and good marks might improve the class's assessment.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What times do Sudou, Hirata, and Kouenji record in the pool?
Sudou swims fifty meters in twenty-five seconds, Hirata in 26.13 seconds, and Kouenji astonishingly in 23.22 seconds despite claiming he isn't interested in winning or losing.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What does Kushida want to know from Ayanokouji after the entrance ceremony?

She wants information about Horikita: whether Ayanokouji is on good terms with her and what kind of person she is, because Horikita turned down Kushida's request for contact info and hasn't talked to anyone, which worries Kushida.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Kushida defuse the confrontation between Yukimura and Hirata after the announcement?
She slips between them, gently takes Yukimura's balled fist, and reasons that it's better for everyone to do their best together since only a month has passed - calming Yukimura completely.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What rules make the Advanced Nurturing High School unusually strict despite its luxurious facilities?

All students must live in on-campus dormitories, contact with anyone outside the school (even immediate family) is forbidden without authorization, and leaving school grounds without permission is strictly forbidden.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What secret sacrifice did Horikita make to lower the English average?

She scored perfect marks in four subjects but deliberately botched English, scoring just fifty-one, to drag down the class average and lower the calculated passing line for Sudou's sake. She even apologizes for not lowering it a bit more.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What 'bombshell' does Horikita drop about her own past?
That this will be her ninth year in a row of being alone - slightly longer if you include kindergarten - meaning she has been alone for as long as she can remember.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Horikita unexpectedly comfort Sudou after his disastrous English exam?

She tells him it was his fault for not reviewing but that he did everything he could without cutting corners or giving up, so he should hold his head high - genuinely acknowledging how hard studying is for him.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Ichinose stop the library confrontation?

The blonde Class B beauty interrupts logically: violence belongs outside, she'd have to report a disturbance, and both sides are provoking each other. Yamawaki's group backs down apologetically, showing her authority over even other classes' students.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What three immediate issues does Horikita identify for climbing out of Class D?
Tardiness, talking during class, and making sure no one fails the upcoming midterm exam.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
According to Kushida, why force herself to get along with Horikita despite hating her?
Because her goal in life is to be liked by everyone, which gives her existence meaning; at least on the surface she wanted to appear to get along with Horikita, though the stress kept building.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Who is Horikita's older brother and what confrontation happens outside the dorms?

Student council president Horikita Manabu. He tells Suzune she'll never reach Class A and orders her to leave the school; when he moves to pin her against the wall, Ayanokouji intervenes and evades Manabu's backhand and kick, surprising him.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How did Chiyabashira trap Ayanokouji in the guidance room?
She hid him in a small kitchenette with strict orders to stay silent until told otherwise, then summoned Horikita for a private conversation so he would overhear it.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What dark side of Kushida does Ayanokouji witness on the school rooftop?
Alone, she vents pure hatred toward Horikita - calling her annoying, wishing she'd die, calling her a harpy - in a low voice completely unlike her usual sunny self.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Which three failing students refuse to join Hirata's study group?
Sudou, Ike, and Yamauchi - due to their rocky relationship with Hirata after Sudou stomped over his introduction game.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How many points do new students receive, and what restrictions apply to them?

Each student receives 100,000 points (worth 100,000 yen) upon admission. Points cannot be exchanged for cash or kept after graduation, they return to the school; students may transfer points to others, but extorting money from peers is forbidden.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What argument does Ayanokouji make against expelling the failing students?

That the school might deduct massive unknown penalties from the class for each expulsion - possibly thousands or tens of thousands of points - an unquantifiable risk; also that everyone has different strengths, like Sudou's athleticism and Ike's communication skills, so intelligence alone doesn't determine worth.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How have Ike, Yamauchi, and Sudou become known in class after three weeks?
Collectively as 'The Idiot Trio' - they chat loudly during class, and the teachers tolerate lateness, dozing, and poor behavior without consequence.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Kouenji draw attention at the pool besides his swimming?
He is the only boy wearing a speedo, which embarrasses the girls, and he mistakes the cheers for Hirata as being directed at himself, saying 'I belong to everyone.'
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
At the convenience store, what does Ayanokouji notice about how Horikita shops?
Despite being careful with her appearance, she buys only the cheapest shampoo and face wash, explaining that she doesn't know when she might need money.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How do different classmates feel about the 100,000-point monthly allowance?
Karuizawa and Ike wish they had even more (200,000-300,000), while Hirata and Kushida find the amount outlandish and fear losing their sense of money management when luxurious school life ends.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Class D receive zero points on May 1?

Class D racked up 98 absences/late arrivals and 391 incidents of talking or using cell phones in class during the first month. The school reflects class behavior in monthly points, so their evaluation was that the class was worth nothing and they wasted all 100,000 points they should have received.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Horikita see through the café setup?

She noticed that the girls seated around them were Class D classmates, that they left far too early after only one or two minutes since everyone came straight after class, and concludes it could not be coincidence.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How do Sudou and Ike justify skipping study sessions when Ayanokouji invites them?
Sudou says he'll cram the night before and has club activities; Ike claims he's doing better now and that high school free time is too precious to waste studying.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Who does Kushida bring to the study group besides Sudou, Ike, and Yamauchi?
Okitani, a slender blue-haired boy who scored thirty-nine on the short test - close to failing but not failing - whom she likely brought deliberately to justify her own participation.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What reward does Chiyabashira promise if no one fails both the midterm and final exams?
A vacation during summer break - 'a dream vacation on an island surrounded by the brilliant blue sea.'
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Who organizes the club fair?
Tachibana, the student council secretary, who delivers the opening remarks before each club's representative explains their club.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Who is Hoshinomiya Chie?

The flirtatious homeroom teacher of Class B and Chiyabashira's best friend since high school - she calls her 'Sae-chan' and gets smacked with a clipboard for hitting on Ayanokouji in the faculty office.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Horikita want the study group to meet in the library instead of the classroom?
To avoid Hirata's study group, which meets during lunch - she absolutely didn't want them interacting.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why is Kushida so desperate to befriend Horikita specifically?

Her goal is to be friends with everyone - not just Class D but students of other classes too - and if she can't befriend one girl in her own class, she feels she'll never achieve that goal. Ayanokouji advises treating Horikita as a special case and waiting for a real coincidence.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Chiyabashira say the students received such a large amount of points?
She explains that the school evaluates its students' talents: everyone passed the entrance examination, which speaks to their value and potential, so the amount reflects an evaluation of their worth.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Ayanokouji perform in the swimming race?
He deliberately aims for the middle of the pack just to avoid last place and supplementary lessons, finishing tenth in thirty-six seconds.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Sudou react to Horikita's apology?
He's stunned like everyone else, then puts his hand over his heart and admits, 'I think I might be in love with Horikita' - afterward completely stopping his antagonism toward her.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
In what year is the narrator speaking when he reflects on these teachings about equality?
2015, which he calls the modern era, noting that nothing about those teachings has changed and the situation has only grown more complex.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What is suspicious about Ayanokouji's test scores according to Chiyabashira?

He scored exactly fifty in every subject on the entrance exam and fifty on the short test. Only 3% of students solved the fifth math problem, which he solved perfectly using complex formulae, yet he failed the tenth problem that 76% completed - suggesting deliberate score manipulation.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What question does Ayanokouji ask Chiyabashira about fairness after the results?

He asks whether today's Japanese society is fair; she says no, not even slightly. He argues Class D tested under unfair conditions since other classes got a week's notice of the changed material, and says humans who can think should strive for at least a little equality.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What does Ayanokouji notice about Horikita during the baseball team's introduction?

She suddenly tenses and turns pale, staring fixedly at the stage - specifically at the student council president - with a complex, unreadable expression, and becomes unresponsive when he speaks to her.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What does Ayanokouji reflect on regarding Horikita in the final scene?

Her will to reach Class A is unshakeable, but the path out of Class D won't be easy - hard to imagine them even reaching Class C. He resolves to do his best for now, adding that he wouldn't mind seeing Horikita smile.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Chiyabashira explain why students are sorted into different classes?

Students are sorted by level of excellence: superior students go to Class A and the least capable to Class D, like major cram schools. Class D is 'the last bastion for failures' - the worst of the worst, the defective.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
From whom does Ayanokouji buy old test papers and for how much?
A third-year Class D student reduced to eating free vegetable meals. After negotiation, he pays 15,000 points transferred in advance, plus the answer key to the admission mock test as a bonus.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why is Sudou declared failed on the midterm despite scoring thirty-nine in English?
The passing grade was set per class by dividing the average score by two and rounding: 79.6 divided by 2 equals 39.8, which rounds up to forty. Sudou scored 39 - just one point short.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
According to Chiyabashira, what must Class D do to guarantee a bright future?
The only option is to overtake Class A - the school guarantees nothing for students in any other class regarding advancement into elite education or workforce placement.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Horikita respond when Ayanokouji suggests she might also want friends?
She quickly and honestly says she prefers to be alone, mocks his transparent desire for someone to invite him to lunch, and tells him to stop worrying about her and think about himself.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What crisis hits Sudou on the day of the midterm?

He fell asleep partway through studying and never reviewed the old English material, leaving him only ten minutes before the English exam. Horikita rushes over to advise him to memorize high-point questions with short answers first.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What claims does Yamauchi make in his self-introduction that Ayanokouji doubts?

Yamauchi says he competed in table tennis in elementary school, was the ace number-four batter on his junior high baseball team, and got injured during the inter-high school championships - but inter-high is a national competition for high school students, so junior high kids should be ineligible.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
On the bus to the entrance ceremony, why does the blond boy refuse to give up his priority seat to the elderly woman?

He argues he has no legal obligation to move, that standing would waste energy on a pointless act, that only he decides whether he moves, and that he has no interest in contributing to society - he cares only for his own satisfaction.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What happens when Ayanokouji asks Horikita about her past experience during lunch?

She takes his vague question as mean-spirited and karate-chops him hard in the side, then delivers a speech justifying violence as humanity's most effective means of resolution and threatens to use it to rehabilitate him.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does the victory celebration take place in Ayanokouji's room?
Ike's room is a mess, as are Sudou's and Yamauchi's; they can't use a girl's room, so Ayanokouji's 'spectacularly plain and empty' room wins out. Kushida approves that it feels nice and clean.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Horikita finally win over Kushida to help with the second study group attempt?

She invites Kushida to Café Palate, treats her to a drink, and admits honestly that she's doing it for herself - to reach Class A - not out of altruism. Kushida agrees because they're classmates, and even asks to join the Class A project itself.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How do the boys' plans collapse during swim class?
The girls emerge onto the second-floor observation deck behind the Professor instead of below, so no one can ogle them; Hasebe, self-conscious about attention, is not amused, and Ike despairs.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Inogashira Kokoro's introduction nearly fail, and what saves it?

She freezes and pales under pressure as cheers like 'Do your best!' make her more nervous. Kushida advises her to take things slowly and not rush, which lets her calm down and finish introducing herself and her hobby of sewing and knitting.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Ayanokouji recruit Kushida for the study group effort?

Kushida is sociable, well-liked by everyone including Ike (who loves her) and Sudou, has relatively high scores, and could rally the class - plus he frames it as a way for Kushida to get closer to Horikita.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What scores did Sudou, Ike, and the class average show on the short test?
Sudou scored fourteen points, Ike twenty-four, and the class average was sixty-five. Kouenji and Yukimura tied for the top score of ninety, solving one of the super-difficult problems.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What deal do Ayanokouji and Horikita strike at the end of chapter 8?

Horikita agrees to look after Sudou and the others so they won't fail, purely as a strategic means for their future advantage - and shakes hands, leading Ayanokouji to remark he'd made a deal with the devil.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What sacrifice does Sudou offer after learning about the test change?

He bows to Horikita, apologizes for being difficult, and offers to take a break from basketball club activities for the remaining week so he can focus on studying - inspired partly by anger at Chiyabashira and the Class C students.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What is Horikita's ultimate conclusion about the failing students after the study group collapses?
That it's better to get rid of the dead weight - if failing students are expelled, the class average rises and no extra effort is wasted.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What demand does Sudou make before rejoining the study group?

A completely honest apology from Horikita for the insulting way she spoke to him. She refuses and instead says 'I hate you, Sudou-kun,' arguing their mutual loathing is trivial since she teaches for her own sake.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Horikita describe Ayanokouji's role in her plans using shogi?
She doesn't need a gold or silver general right now - she wants a pawn, calling Ayanokouji easy to manipulate compared with others in Class D like Hirata, whom she says she can't use.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What makes Sudou explode at Horikita during the tutoring session?

After she calls him ignorant and incompetent and mocks his dream of becoming a professional basketball player - saying he runs from challenges, wouldn't make a team, and could never earn a living - Sudou grabs her collar and storms out.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
How does Kushida maneuver her way into the study group despite Horikita's ban?

She first gets Horikita to approve Okitani as long as he's serious about not failing, then claims she barely passed the short test herself by guessing on multiple-choice questions and wants to avoid a bad grade - leaving Horikita no consistent grounds to refuse.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
Why does Ayanokouji find the dormitory situation ideal for himself personally?

Because people cannot contact students without permission - not even friends or immediate family - he finally has freedom from others' eyes and words, and he can begin a completely new life without drawing attention.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What is Hirata's plan to deal with losing the points, and how do Sudou and Horikita respond?

Hirata asks classmates individually to join a discussion on earning points, urging everyone to stop being late, talking, or using phones in class. Sudou refuses to cooperate and walks out, and Horikita also refuses as meaningless; Ayanokouji declines too so Horikita won't be singled out.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What bullying ideas appear in the group chat after Satou joins?

Satou suggests completely ignoring Horikita, hitting her as payback, hiding her shoes, and making her cry; when asked whose side he's on, Ayanokouji declares neutrality and warns that bullying will cause trouble if the school learns of it.
You are a knowledgeable assistant for the light novel 'Classroom of the Elite' (Volume 1). Answer accurately and concisely based on the novel.
What does Ayanokouji offer to buy from Chiyabashira to save Sudou?

One point to apply to Sudou's English test score, invoking her admission-day claim that points can buy anything at the school. She names an 'exceptional price' of 100,000 points; Ayanokouji pays part and Horikita arrives saying 'I'll pay, too,' covering the rest together.
